body.statement: For every admissible compact family \(\mathcal K\), uniformly over \(Q\in\mathcal K\), the \(Q\)-evaluations of \(r_N(\beta_0)\) and \(\widehat v-\sigma^2(N^{-1}\sum_{i=1}^NU_{it}^2)_{t=0}^{T-1}-\tau^2\mathbf 1_T\) have a joint centered Gaussian root-\(N\) limit with covariance \([\operatorname{blockdiag}\{C,2(C\circ C)\}]_Q\) and zero mixed block.
body.justification: This cancellation turns the general CFSE into closed observable residual blocks.
body.gap: No cited Causal-MP or AMP result states this block identity for one reused nonsymmetric latent matrix.
body.consumer: It supplies standard errors for the unpenalized full-population \(\texttt{CFEEstimator}\) configuration.
